futureLetter.title: Transmission From Future Aarna
body: Take a breath. You spent so many days worrying if everything would work out, if exams would define you, or if you'd figure out where you belong.

I'm writing back to tell you: you made it. You built an incredible life on your own terms. You still laugh too loudly, you still refuse to act like a boring grown-up, and you're surrounded by genuine people who love your chaotic magic.
And yes, that school friend who was like your brother? He's still cheering for you from the sidelines, just like he promised.
futureLetter.signoff: With endless love from the person you're becoming,

futureBirthdayArchive.title: Sealed Birthday Archive // Year 2030+
futureBirthdayArchive.status: Encrypted • Unlocking With Every Passing Year
futureBirthdayArchive.teaser: A digital time capsule containing future birthday messages and lifelong sibling wishes.
futureBirthdayArchive.unlockedMessage: No matter how many candles are on the cake, you will always be the girl with forehead dots and a smile that lit up the whole back row. Happy birthday in every timeline.

unwrittenChapters.title: The First Solo Empire
unwrittenChapters.description: Stepping into rooms where you command the stage, building careers or creative projects that leave people in awe.

unwrittenChapters.title: The Infinite Passport
unwrittenChapters.description: Standing on shores you haven't seen yet, tasting new street food, and laughing under unfamiliar stars.

unwrittenChapters.title: The Unshakable Peace
unwrittenChapters.description: Waking up on a quiet morning knowing you are exactly where you are supposed to be, deeply loved and safe.

unwrittenChapters.title: The Lifelong Sisterhood
unwrittenChapters.description: Calling your school benchmate 10 years from now just to complain about something completely ridiculous and laugh like it's Desk 12 all over again.
